description_excerpt: Job Description We are seeking an experienced Hardware Engineer to design, develop, and validate electronic hardware systems. The role involves schematic design, prototype development, hardware bring-up, component library management, and technical documentation creation. The successful candidate will work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality hardware solutions.
